messages:
marco: quick check — can someone run the config gate for the new model upload? Two things I noticed in the onboarding bundle: the weight_uri looks non-standard and tokenizer offsets include -1 which I think the runtime treats specially. CI lint also threw a legacy-field warning for `vocab_size`.
sasha: grabbing the bundle now. initial note: weight_uri is `s3:/redwood/models/orca-mini-v2/weights.tar` (single slash after scheme) — that will break the `uri.parse()` path normalization. also seeing `tokenizer: { special_tokens: [{id: -1, token: "<pad>"}] }` — runtime assumes non-negative ids or null. quick reproduce:
```json
{ "weight_uri": "s3:/redwood/models/orca-mini-v2/weights.tar", "tokenizer": { "special_tokens": [{"id": -1, "token": "<pad>"}] } }
```
ci-bot: config-gate v2.1 triggered by @marco at 2134567890 — check results: FAIL
- schema: tokenizer.special_tokens[].id must be null or >= 0
- parser: weight_uri scheme recognized but path normalization failed (expected `s3://bucket/path` or `gs://bucket/path`)
See CI details: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/12987
liz: I can patch both in a tiny PR — normalize weight_uri in gatekeeper (auto-correct single-slash -> double) and replace sentinel -1 with `null` for special tokens when we detect legacy exporters. Will also add a lint rule to fail fast.
henry: one more runtime gotcha to watch: if `config.max_input_length` < `tokenizer.context_window`, we hit an eager-fallback that changes KV cache behavior. Please ensure onboarding config sets `max_seq_len` >= tokenizer.context_window. Otherwise dedupe/streaming tests will flake.
mika: added a unit test in `eng-ml/tests/test_config_lint.py` that covers: (1) `weight_uri` normalization, (2) `special_tokens` negative id -> convert to null, and (3) legacy `vocab_size` key mapping to `vocab_length`. Pushed branch `config-lint-model-onboard`.
marco: awesome — @liz can you drop the PR link here when ready? @sasha can you do a quick review once CI passes? If green, we'll promote the bundle to staging and run the smoke-serving job. small checklist for merge:
- fix weight_uri normalization (auto-correct + warn)
- map `vocab_size` -> `vocab_length` with warning
- convert `special_tokens.id == -1` -> null
- ensure `max_seq_len >= tokenizer.context_window`
sasha: noted. i'll prioritize review after lunch. also adding a one-liner in docs: "onboard bundles should use `s3://` or `gs://` and avoid negative token ids". :memo:
liz: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eng-ml/pull/432 — contains gate changes + tests. tagging reviewers.
marco: perfect, thanks everyone. will run the staging promotion once CI/flakecheck is green. :thumbsup:
